explication: OOOSplat is a local Tauri desktop app that turns a video or image sequence into a Gaussian Splatting project, then supports preview, editing, and export. The main flow runs from the React task UI through Tauri commands into a Rust pipeline: prepare frames, reconstruct cameras and geometry, train splats, and publish a validated PLY. Separate branches cover incremental reshoots, project history, Gaussian editing/animation, and opt-in telemetry. The README documents these capabilities; sampled source confirms the app calls and project persistence, but not every internal pipeline call.
